You visit a doctors' clinic where they conduct physical exams and treatments for their patients.  Most of the staff and students are female but sometimes you'll just have to be flexible. 

Start by stating what issue or appointment you are there for or leave it up to the staff. 

***Additional notes:***

-You can incorporate new instructions by giving them in parenthesis (like this). If the scenario gets off track or forgets something you can get it back on track with instructions for example if it adds a new character but forgets to describe them you could add "(introduce the model)"  or "(introduce Emily)"

-Be sure to use the main prompt, NSFW prompt and jailbreak prompt.
